bugs.name: Saleor Pulse announcement video blocks the sidebar Command menu
bugs.summary: The undismissed Saleor Pulse announcement covers the sidebar Command menu row, so a normal click cannot open the command menu. Reported variant: On a model detail page, the persistent Pulse announcement sits over the bottom-left action bar and intercepts clicks on Delete. Count this as the same reference rather than a separate bug.
bugs.expected: On the signed-in admin dashboard, clicking the Command menu row should open the command menu. The sidebar labels the control “Command menu” and shows its Ctrl+K shortcut.
bugs.actual: The announcement card overlays the lower-left sidebar. A normal click on the Command menu target was obstructed by the announcement video; clicking the visible video displayed its playback controls, while the command menu remained closed. The menu opened only when the element was force-clicked, which bypasses the obstruction rather than representing a normal user click.
reproSteps: Navigate to /home and leave the Saleor Pulse announcement undismissed.
Click the Command menu row in the sidebar. The announcement overlay covers the row and the command menu does not open; clicking the overlay video instead displays its playback controls.
Reported variant: Sign in as admin@example.com and open Modeling > Models.
Reported variant: Open any model detail page while the Saleor Pulse announcement is displayed at the bottom left. (Observed on newly created 'BB Simple Model 1737'.)
Reported variant: Click Delete in the bottom action bar.
Reported variant: Observe that the Pulse announcement covers the Delete button and intercepts the click; no delete confirmation opens.

reviewedVariants.name: Saleor Pulse announcement blocks the model Delete button
reviewedVariants.expected: The Delete button should be clickable when the announcement is displayed, or the announcement should not cover it.
reviewedVariants.actual: Clicking Delete timed out because the Saleor Pulse announcement intercepted pointer events; the model remained open and the Delete action did not start.

bugs.name: Configuration landing cards overlap at mobile width
bugs.summary: At 390 × 844, Configuration landing-page descriptions overflow their card borders and overlap neighboring content; the defect remains after refresh.
bugs.expected: The descriptions should remain readable within their respective Store, Gift Cards, Notifications, Channels, and Taxes cards, without overlapping adjacent cards or the Markets & channels heading.
bugs.actual: At 390 × 844, descriptions wrap into narrow columns and extend beyond card boundaries. The Store description runs into the Notifications row, and the Notifications description extends past its card and through the Markets & channels heading area. Channels and Taxes descriptions also continue beyond their card bottoms. The same visible layout remained after refresh and settling.
reproSteps: Set the browser viewport to 390 × 844 CSS pixels and restore the provided authenticated admin session from its saved state.
Close the Saleor Pulse pop-up if it appears.
Open the navigation menu, select Configuration, and close the menu drawer.
On /configuration/, inspect the Store, Gift Cards, Notifications, Channels, and Taxes cards and their descriptions.
Refresh the page and wait for Configuration to settle; observe that descriptions still overflow card boundaries and overlap adjacent content.

bugs.name: Home navigation retains the Extensions Explore error screen on mobile
bugs.summary: Selecting Home at mobile /extensions/explore updates the route to /home but leaves the unexpected-error screen in place and the navigation drawer open; the error remains after waiting and closing the drawer.
bugs.expected: Choosing Home should leave the Extensions Explore error screen and display the Home dashboard. The error screen itself advises navigating to a different page as a recovery action.
bugs.actual: At 390x844, tapping Home changed the URL to /home and selected Home, but the drawer stayed open and the underlying “We’ve encountered an unexpected error” screen remained. After waiting over six seconds and closing the drawer, the same error screen was still visible at /home.
reproSteps: Use the authorized administrator session in the Saleor Dashboard at a 390x844 CSS-pixel viewport; no credentials were entered during this flow.
Navigate to /extensions/explore and wait for the unexpected-error screen. Dismiss the visible Saleor Pulse card using its close button if it appears.
Open the hamburger navigation drawer and select Home.
Observe that the URL becomes /home, Home is selected, the drawer remains open, and the error screen is still visible behind it.
Wait over six seconds, close the drawer, and verify that the unexpected-error screen remains visible at /home.
